description: This file extends the VoiceWakeOverlayController with UI management functions, including presenting an overlay window, ensuring window creation, bringing the overlay to front, calculating target frames, updating window frames, measuring height based on text content, and handling dismissal frames. It is part of the overlay UI layer for the VoiceWake feature in a Mac application.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Shows the voice wake overlay, initializes the window if necessary, and manages its presentation, visibility state, and logging.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures the overlay window if it hasn't been already, including setting up the hosting view.

methods.name: bringToFrontIfVisible
methods.description: Brings the overlay window to front if it is visible.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target frame for positioning the overlay window based on the screen's visible frame.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame to the target frame, optionally with animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height needed to display the overlay content based on attributed text and layout.

methods.name: dismissTargetFrame
methods.description: Calculates a new frame for dismissing animation based on the dismissal reason and outcome.
